analysis:
Reviewed alias_planner.go (head only) and consumer.go (patch plus base). The changes add request-absolute deadline plumbing. In consumer.go, chat (~l.937) and generic (~l.1343) paths compute deadlineForWork via PromptWorkDeadlineForRequest and fallbackDeadline via firstcontent.DurationWithinContext. Both are passed into AdmissionRequest as FallbackDeadline and DeadlineForWork, and into DispatchRequest as FallbackDeadline and PromptDeadlineForWork. After admission, deadline is set to max(fallbackDeadline, deadlineForWork(model, promptwork.FromContext(...))). The patch changes no authentication, billing reservation, encryption, attestation, App Attest, or provider-authorization code. alias_planner.go adds maybeFallbackAliasWithDeadline, which wraps AliasPlanner.FallbackWithDeadline and returns an extra bool. Its AliasPlanner struct gains Calibration and MinDecodeTPS fields. The 'internal/inference/routeplan' import is unchanged in kind.

Residual items for integration:
- The effective first-content deadline can only grow, via max(). Its growth is bounded by request context only if DurationWithinContext and PromptWorkDeadlineForRequest, which are not visible, clamp to the context. Prompt-size-driven extension is also not visibly capped, so a large prompt could hold provider or queue slots longer. This relates to T-002 and availability, and was not verifiable here.
- Chat reconcileFetchedMedia may update deadline before fallbackDeadline is computed. This ordering looks correct in the chat path. The generic path is not shown with media inlining.
- The reservation and refund logic, and the unseen routeplan, admission, and dispatch implementations that consume the new fields, were not examined.

No concrete security regression found in the visible diff.
